scientific_integrity: Original claim is the joint exact face/ray classification and arithmetic regular-grid census. Standard orthant-section circuit arguments and the earlier vertex-normal cone definition are acknowledged; no independent audit or formal certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Requires cyclic planar unit directions with each consecutive gap strictly below pi.
The enumerated extreme rays are defined modulo the common-translation lineality.
The closed parity-dependent ray count applies to equally spaced directions only.
Finite numerical checks do not establish the all-n theorem; the mathematical argument supplies the general proof.
Potential equivalent older results in alternative polyhedral-cone terminology have not been completely excluded.
title: Complete facet and extreme-ray spectra of planar vertex-normal cones
